name: @hdsp/oracle-client
description: Framework-agnostic Oracle connection-pool client with retry and circuit-breaker logic (Hybrid Architecture roadmap, Phase 6 Task 6.1). Extracted verbatim from the backend's OraclePoolService so it is consumable both by the NestJS backend (via a thin DI wrapper) and the standalone connector/ package, without duplicating the pool/circuit-breaker implementation in two places.
